entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A human mage from Drakeston on Fiora who became a planeswalker and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.

entities.name: Marsh
entities.description: Dack's friend and fellow adept young mage, killed in a fight with brutes.

entities.name: Drakeston
entities.description: A village on the plane of Fiora, Dack's home.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane on which Dack's village lies.

events.summary: Dack and Marsh, adept young mages lacking judgment, pick a fight with brutes one night and Marsh is killed.
events.quote: One night, their genius got the best of them and they picked a fight with brutes, resulting in the death of Marsh.

events.summary: Dack's spark ignites at Marsh's death and he becomes a planeswalker and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.
events.quote: In that moment, Dack’s spark ignited and he became a Planeswalker—and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.

relations.note: Friends and fellow mages in their youth.
relations.quote: As a youth, Dack and his friend Marsh were adept mages
Drakeston, a village on the plane of Fiora.
